race.comment: ARABIAN CHARM (8) appeals as the horse with the most upside if she returns in the right order. Her debut fifth at Belmont, beaten two lengths after being near the top of betting, reads well enough for this, and a Lark Hill trial win gives confidence she is more forward than the plain Saturday-company run that ended her first campaign. SHADES OF BLUE (4) is the most interesting debutant after a solid second in his latest Lark Hill trial, and his family page gives him more substance than the average first starter. EASY GOING (12) also debuts with a helpful inside draw, a Lark Hill trial within touching distance, and strong sibling form through Facile, so she has enough profile to run a race first time out. LENNY GOOD CHILD (3) has claims on debut.
